Independent multiplicity analysis: the interior double root contributes two intervals of width a^(1/4)(1+o(1)), with weight tending to1. The interior simple root contributes O(sqrt(a)), negligible at the fourth-root scale. Away from both roots, the squared polynomial has a positive compact minimum. Dominated difference quotients give twice this weighted sublevel mass, so the limit is4. This is a new mixed-multiplicity case, not a reuse of the earlier simple-root oracle.
